response.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT o.timespan AS ts, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT ts, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM b), a AS (SELECT ts, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE share > avg_share
